page.layout: One block of text in a single column, with a printed page number at the top right and a woodcut ornament band above the heading. Full-width title heading at the top, then the body text with a historiated initial H at the left. A catchword-like signature mark "¶. ij" sits below the last line, centred-right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: PASTORIBVS, DIACONIS ET SENIORIBVS reformatarum Gallici Regni Ecclesiarum, honorandis Dominis & fratribus, Theodorus Beza gratiam & pacem à Deo Patre & Domino nostro Iesu Christo.
main_text.p: HONORANDI fratres in Domino, praeterquā quòd ipsa Christiana religio in genere, & nominatim ea vocatio, qua nos Deus domi suæ dignatur, nos ad sacrosanctā mortis Domini historiam summa cura & studio cognoscendam, vsuíque suo applicandam adstringit: luctuosissimæ illæ tragoediæ, quibus Gallia totos iam annos triginta fensim absumitur, ab iis nefariis hominibus excitatæ, qui tuendæ veræ, quam vocant, religionis studium ambitiosissimis conatibus suis praetexunt, & cuius incendij flamma ad has

page.notes: The initial H is a large woodcut historiated letter; it is joined to "ONORANDI" in the transcription as "HONORANDI". The first line of the body is in small capitals ("ONORANDI"). Some letters are blurred ("tragoediæ", "fensim"); the word "praeterquā" and "quòd" read as printed. The printed signature at the foot is "¶. ij".
